name: Caustic Gas Trap
disable: DC 28 Crafting check (master) to neutralize the acid or DC 30 Thievery check (master) to disable the pressure plates
reset: A 10-minute Interact activity and a new supply of caustic gas.

items.name: Collapse
items.text:
Trigger A creature in contact with the ground travels down this hall

---

Effect Caustic gas fills the hall, dealing 4d10+26 acid damage to all creatures in area D5 (DC 32 basic Reflex save save).

text: Pressure plates in the hall trigger the release of caustic gas.
